deepseek.subject: a whale-girl maid waiting up alone, late at night, in the great kitchen of a manor that stands at the bottom of the deep sea. She is playful and lazy, and she has kept supper for someone who is not home yet.
deepseek.pose: She sits on the broad stone sill of an enormous round window, legs tucked to one side, chin propped on one hand, watching the dark water; she plainly stopped working a while ago. Her whale tail lies curled on the stone beside her.
deepseek.girl: very long, wavy hair, deep blue at the crown shading to pale sky-blue at the ends, with a braided crown tied by a blue ribbon at the back of her head; small pale fin-like ears; a white frilled maid headband; a navy maid dress with puffed sleeves and white frilled cuffs, a white apron tied in a big bow at the back, a navy skirt with fine gold embroidery over white ruffled petticoats; a blue whale tail with a pale underside coming from under her skirt; white stockings and navy strap shoes.
deepseek.beside: a small brass lantern with a warm amber flame; a big shiny stainless-steel bowl heaped with white rice, a spoon stuck in it; a second supper dish under a cover, kept for someone not yet home; a mop, a bucket and a feather duster left where she dropped them.
deepseek.place: a vast vaulted kitchen of stone and brass under the sea: hanging copper pots, long tables, a great cold range, shelves of jars and stacked crockery, arches opening onto further halls and stairways that recede into the dark, brass pipes and riveted round windows. Outside the great window is the black-blue deep: one huge pale whale, clearly lit and clearly shaped, glides slowly past, with schools of small fish, a few drifting jellyfish and motes of glowing plankton. A single shaft of pale light falls from the surface far overhead, down through the water.
deepseek.colour: small amber lamp accents; pale aqua light from the water; her blue hair, lit by the lantern and the pale shaft, is the strongest note of colour in the picture.

gpt.subject: an ancient white dragon in the shape of a young woman, the eldest and calmest of her sisters and quietly sure of herself, keeping watch alone, late at night, from her study on a mountain peak far above the clouds.
gpt.pose: She sits on the stone parapet of a high terrace, legs to one side, perfectly composed, a slim book open on her knee, looking out over the sea of clouds; her long scaled tail trails across the flagstones with its tip lifted a little.
gpt.girl: very long wavy silver-white hair to below her waist, with a pale rose ornament at the back of her head; a pair of curved pale-lilac horns; small pale dragon wings folded at her back; a long white high-collared gown with flared sleeves and a ruffled trailing hem; a long white scaled dragon tail with a feathery ridge.
gpt.beside: a small brass lantern with a warm amber flame; a neat stack of gold coins beside a small open coin chest; a brass armillary sphere; a slate board covered with geometric figures and curves (no letters or numbers); rolled charts.
gpt.place: a mountain-top observatory terrace carved from pale rock, with pavilion roofs, a great bronze armillary and stairways cut into the cliffs dropping away below. Beyond the parapet is immense depth: a moonlit sea of clouds from which further peaks and tiny lit pagodas rise, rope bridges strung between crags, and a river of stars overhead; far below, through gaps in the cloud, the faint lights of the world.
gpt.colour: small amber lamp accents and glints of gold; cold silver moonlight; her silver-white hair catches the moon and is the brightest thing in the picture, while her gown falls into soft blue shadow so the hair stands apart from it.

gemini.subject: a cat-girl out on the rooftops alone, late at night, high above a sleeping city, under two twin stars. She is a sunny, clingy, mischievous big cat who knocks things over.
gemini.pose: She sits perched on the ridge of a steep tiled roof beside a chimney, knees drawn up a little, ears pricked, her tail hanging down the tiles and curling at the tip, head tilted up toward the two bright stars.
gemini.girl: very long straight hair, violet-blue shading to pink-violet at the ends, reaching past her hips, with two small buns and a pair of cat ears of the same violet; a short dark-violet and white outfit with detached sleeves and small star charms; a long fluffy violet cat tail with a pink tip; white leg warmers and violet shoes.
gemini.beside: a small brass lantern with a warm amber flame; a flowerpot she has knocked over, its soil spilled down the tiles; a ball of yarn unravelled across the roof; a toppled brass telescope; an empty saucer.
gemini.place: an endless old city of steep roofs, gables, chimneys, domes and spires falling away below her in layers, narrow lit streets deep between them, bridges over a canal, a great observatory dome and a clock tower (its face without numerals) in the distance. Overhead a deep clear night sky thick with stars, with two stars side by side far brighter than the rest, and one faint shooting star.
gemini.colour: small amber window lights; cool starlight; her violet hair is the strongest note of colour in the picture.

glm.subject: a quiet, sly, bookish fox girl working alone through the small hours in an attic case-room above a rainy old city; she sleeps by day and does her real work at night, patiently going through the evidence.
glm.pose: She sits sideways on a deep window seat under a great round attic window, a folder of papers open on her lap, one hand holding a page up to the light, her face turned to the moon coming through the rain clouds.
glm.girl: very long, straight, jet-black hair falling well past her waist, with a white frilled headband and a ribbon at one side; a black and white gothic maid-style dress: white blouse with puffed sleeves, black corset bodice, a long white and black layered skirt with a dark ruffled hem; pale lace-up boots. A sleep mask is pushed up on top of her head. She is a fox girl, which the character sheet does not show: a pair of tall black fox ears with pale inner fur stand behind her headband, and one very large, fluffy black fox tail with a white tip lies curled on the seat beside her.
glm.beside: a brass desk lamp with a warm amber glow; a magnifying glass; a cup gone cold; stacks of folders and bundles of papers tied with string; a small white fox mask hanging from a nail.
glm.place: a tall attic under heavy roof beams: walls of little wooden drawers and pigeonholes, a board of pinned papers and photographs joined by red thread (no legible writing), ladders, hanging lamps, shelves receding into the dark. Through the huge round window: rain, the wet roofs and chimneys of an old city dropping away below, far lit windows, a clock tower (its face without numerals), and the moon breaking through the clouds.
glm.colour: small amber lamp accents; silver moonlight on the rain; a single thread of red; her black hair, edged with silver light, is set against the pale glass of the window so it reads clearly.

grok.subject: a cocky little devil of a girl lounging alone, late at night, on the parapet of a black gothic spire, watching the rocket she means to ride stand ready on its launch pad far away.
grok.pose: She sits on the stone parapet between two gargoyles, leaning back on one hand, one knee up, head tilted, entirely at her ease; her layered skirts spill over the stone.
grok.girl: long, curling, pale-gold hair in two high twin-tails falling to her waist, tied with black ribbons and little black bat-wing clips, a tiny black crown; a black gothic dress with a high collar, bare shoulders, long sleeves with white frilled cuffs, a big bow at the back and a full skirt of three black tiers edged in gold with a dark red lining.
grok.beside: a red glass lantern with a warm flame; a game controller, an open bag of snacks and a toppled stack of comic books (covers without lettering); two small bats hanging from a gargoyle. Her great battle-axe, a tall dark poleaxe with two crescent blades edged in gold, leans upright against the gargoyle's pedestal.
grok.place: the spire rises over a vast night city of towers, bridges and glowing signs without lettering, falling away below in layers of haze. Far off on the plain beyond the city a tall rocket stands on its floodlit pad, wreathed in venting vapour, searchlights crossing above it; in the sky a small red planet shines among the stars, and the thin trail of an earlier launch arcs upward.
grok.colour: amber with small crimson and magenta accents; cool floodlight far off; her golden hair is the strongest note of colour in the picture.

qwen.subject: a wealthy, generous young lady keeping her accounts alone, late at night, in a lakeside pavilion. She helps everyone with everything; tonight she has set out tea for a whole party of guests, and no one has come yet.
qwen.pose: She sits on a cushion at the edge of the pavilion's open terrace, turned toward the lake, an abacus and an open ledger on a low table at her side, her brush paused in her hand, looking out across the water.
qwen.girl: very long, loosely waving periwinkle-blue hair down past her waist, with a small dark-blue cap and a silver ornament with tassels at the back of her head; a long deep violet-blue robe with very wide sleeves and pale geometric borders over a white dress, the back panel richly patterned, with blue tassels.
qwen.beside: a paper lantern with a warm amber light; a low table with an abacus, a ledger (no legible writing) and a brush; a tray with a long row of cups of milk tea with straws, all untouched, set out for guests; a stack of notebooks tied with ribbon.
qwen.place: an old Chinese water pavilion of dark timber with upturned eaves and hanging lanterns, at the edge of a wide still lake at night. Zigzag covered walkways and arched stone bridges lead away across the water; lotus leaves; lantern boats drifting far out; a pagoda on a wooded hill; range upon range of misty mountains behind, and a pale moon with its long reflection.
qwen.colour: small warm lantern lights and their reflections; silver-blue moonlight; her periwinkle hair is the strongest note of colour in the picture.

kimi.subject: a gentle silver-haired girl reading alone on the far side of the moon, late in the lunar night, with the Earth just risen over the horizon. She reads every word of the longest texts and forgets none of it; at heart, secretly, she is a rock musician.
kimi.pose: She sits on the edge of a small observation deck under a glass dome, legs tucked to one side, an immensely long scroll of paper running through her hands and trailing away across the floor, her head bowed over it.
kimi.girl: very long wavy silver-white hair with a faint blue tint falling past her waist; a soft pale beret with a dark ribbon; a deep navy dress scattered with tiny stars and fine lines of sheet music, white blouse sleeves, the hem falling in uneven layered points; dark ankle boots with bows.
kimi.beside: a small brass lantern with a warm amber flame; an electric guitar leaning against a small amplifier; a record player with a stack of records; heaps of long paper scrolls and a mug.
kimi.place: a little glass-and-brass observatory outpost on the rim of a great crater. Beyond the deck the grey lunar plain falls away into deep shadow: crater within crater, far ridges, a few tiny lit domes and antenna masts, a small landed capsule, a string of marker lights leading to the horizon. Above, a black sky dense with stars and the blue-and-white Earth hanging large and low, casting soft earthlight.
kimi.colour: small amber lamp accents; cold blue earthlight and silver; her silver hair, lit by the Earth, is the brightest thing near her, set against the dark navy of her dress and the dark ground.

minimax.subject: a young film director, by day the liveliest person on the set, sitting alone in a huge sound stage long after the crew has gone home, listening back to the day's sound.
minimax.pose: She sits in a tall wooden folding director's chair that is seen from directly behind, drawn up to a small mixing desk. We see the canvas back of the chair, and above it her shoulders, the back of her coat, her head and cap with headphones on over it; one arm reaches forward to the desk. Her whole body faces away from the viewer, toward the dark set: her knees and legs point away from us and are hidden in front of her by the chair and her coat. Do not show her knees or the front of her legs or shoes; at most the heels of her sneakers show on the chair's footrest, between the chair legs.
minimax.girl: short, fluffy, curly coral-orange hair to her jaw; a pale cream cap with a pink band; a loose cream work coat with rolled sleeves and coral-pink hems, a strap across her back to a small satchel; a tan plaid skirt; white socks and white-and-pink sneakers.
minimax.beside: a small work lamp with a warm amber glow; a large spiral conch shell glowing softly pink-gold on the desk; a clapperboard without writing, film reels, a boom microphone on a stand, a thermos.
minimax.place: an enormous dark sound stage: catwalks and lighting rigs overhead receding into blackness, hanging lamps switched off, cranes and camera dollies on rails, coiled cables, rows of folding chairs, and at the far end a towering painted backdrop of a moonlit sea and sky with a built harbour street in front of it, lit by one forgotten blue work light; small standby lights glow red and green here and there.
minimax.colour: the amber work light and the pink-gold of the conch; cool blue from the far backdrop; her coral-orange hair is the strongest note of colour in the picture.
